# Make draft countdown announcements clear for screen readers

## What & Why
The recovery countdown changes frequently inside a live status notice. A screen reader may repeat every update instead of announcing only useful milestones, making the notice difficult to follow.

## Done looks like
- The recovery notice communicates availability and expiration without excessive repeated announcements.
- Countdown updates remain visible for sighted users.
- Accessibility-focused browser coverage verifies the notice and expiration announcement.
